name: Twig
description:
A thin Twig, common around many trees...
It's so weak that it's like you're using your bare hands...

name: Stick
description: A thin piece of wood, common around many trees...

name: Old Frying Pan
description:
Even though it's used for cooking, it's also good for some whacking.
Hit the right spot, and you may even stun your foes...

name: Old Wooden Club
description:
It's among the simplest of all weapons, but it gets the job done, sometimes...
Unlocks the "Double Attack" Skill

name: Worn-Out Wooden Bat
description:
A Wooden Bat, that's good for getting to 2nd Base...
Unlocks the "Strike" Skill

name: Beginner's Bow
description:
Perfect for getting shots out quickly, even if there aren't good.
Unlocks the "Quick Aim" Skill

name: Squeaky Hammer
description:
A Squeaky Hammer to BONK and annoy your enemies!
Unlocks the "BONK!" Skill

name: Magical Cane
description:
A Magical Cane that has strange power! (Requires: 5 EP to attack.)
Unlocks the "Big Orb" Skill

name: Toy Golf Club
description:
Just because it has a toy in the name doesn't mean it's not a weapon...
Toys can be very dangerous like this golf club...

name: Wooden Bat
description:
A Wooden Bat that's good for some HOMERUNS.
Unlocks the "HomeRun" Skill

name: Short Leaf Sword
description: A tiny Leaf sword, it's so light that you might be able to move with the wind with this.

name: Leafwhipper
description:
A long Leaf filled with Magical properties to make it an actual weapon.
Unlocks the "Quad-Whip" Skill
Dizzy Chance: 5% ~ When you perform a Normal Attack!
